mod.rustlingspots.description: Adds dynamic Rustling Spots that reveal hidden Pokemon or themed loot based on their environment. Each spot family has its own customizable pools, offering an immersive and lightweight way to enrich exploration.
command.rustlingspots.spawn.success: Spawned rustling spot for family '%s' at %s, %s, %s
message.rustlingspots.pokemon.1: You sense something watching you from %2$s... A wild %1$s appears!
message.rustlingspots.pokemon.3: Your curiosity paid off. A wild %1$s emerges from %2$s!
message.rustlingspots.loot.1: You search through %3$s and find %1$s x %2$s.
message.rustlingspots.loot.2: Looks like %2$s was tucked away in %3$s. You pick up %1$s x %2$s.
message.rustlingspots.loot.3: %3$s settles down, but you still manage to grab a small stash of loot. (%1$s x %2$s)
message.rustlingspots.multi_pokemon.1: %2$s erupts and several Pokemon rush out: %1$s.
message.rustlingspots.multi_pokemon.2: %2$s was packed with activity. Multiple Pokemon appear at once: %1$s.
message.rustlingspots.multi_loot.2: %2$s pays out multiple finds at once: %1$s.
message.rustlingspots.empty.1: The rustling fades away... but nothing was there.
message.rustlingspots.empty.2: You check the spot carefully, but it turns out to be empty.
message.rustlingspots.empty.3: Something was here a second ago, but the spot is already empty.
